name: Issue-to-PR Coding Agent
workflow: Given a GitHub issue, the agent proposes a patch, runs tests, and drafts a pull request for human review.
non_goals: Merge pull requests without human approval

tools.name: patch_workspace
tools.purpose: Edit files in a temporary branch

tools.name: create_pull_request
tools.purpose: Open a pull request after tests pass

launch_blockers: Needs the prompt-injection fixture pack wired into the coding agent's runtime eval suite
